classification.difficultyReason: Direct recognition or a familiar short procedure. Compare all four members; −9 is the least.

content.prompt:
Let $A$ be a subset of $\mathbb R$. Define the following.
$$\begin{aligned}\max A&=x\in A\text{ where }x\ge a\text{ for any }a\in A\\\min A&=x\in A\text{ where }x\le a\text{ for any }a\in A\end{aligned}$$
Find $\min\{-4,9,-9,8\}$.

answer.worked: $-9$ belongs to the set and is no greater than any other element. Hence $\min\{-4,9,-9,8\}=-9$.
